Assignment Question:
A cybersecurity firm is building a lightweight cryptographic module for an encryption algorithm. The system generates numeric security tokens. To ensure high security, tokens that are Prime numbers are flagged as "High-Security Keys" and routed to the Secure Vault server. Tokens that are Not Prime numbers are routed to the Standard Server.
The development team isolates the validation logic into a custom package named CryptoUtils. Inside this package, they design a utility class named TokenValidator containing a method called checkSecurity(int token). This method evaluates whether the token is a prime number or not and prints its classification.
The system intake portal is managed by a separate execution file outside this package. It scans the incoming token, checks if it is non-alphabetic, ensures that it is not negative, and then imports the package to perform the security analysis.
 
·       Input Format:
·        A single line containing an integer representing the security token.
·        
·       Output Format:
A string message indicating whether the token is a Prime number or Not Prime (or a validation error message).
